name: Shiga Soutarou
source:
Work: Surgeon
Hobby: Work

Soutarou is a workaholic as he is almost always busy, including your first meeting at the matchmaking party when he left almost as soon as you arrived due to an emergency at the hospital. He may not speak much, but he has made his intentions clear with you.
